title: Your Partner in
paragraphs: With over three decades of sports marketing experience, 26West Sport Ltd delivers expert support, in-depth advice and exceptional results across media rights, commercial partnerships, event commercialisation and strategic development in sport.

Having worked for media partners, agencies, commercial rightsholders, and governing bodies, we bring insider understanding of the unique commercial challenges of the sports business. Every project is tailor made to meet each clients specific needs and objectives.

Recent projects have included media rights sales & strategy, media rights & production tendering, team sponsorship strategy & sales, global technology company sports solutions consultancy, event hosting commercial support, event acquisition, commercial organisation structuring, sports investment advice and launching new sports events.
